notes: v1.2.3: Vocals are front and centre and the mix is clean. The v1.2.2 mix clipped hard (true peak 1.7-2.0, the old render measured the clamped WAV and called it 'loud') and the vocal was buried (0.46-0.64x the band). Fixed by rebalancing: band gains down (kick 0.42, bass 0.22, pads 0.06 triangle not buzzy sawtooth), vocal peak up (0.55 Smooth) with less self-peak (formant +2dB, double 0.35, harmony 0.28), more air (lowpass up to 4800Hz), a short feedback delay send on the vocal for space, and the master down to 0.5 so the full-mix peak is ~0.7-0.8 with no clipping. A master compressor was tried and REMOVED — it raised the peak in this engine (A/B: Pop +7.2%). Guitar cache + incremental scheduler + progress UI unchanged from v1.2.2; watchdog + Audio diagnostic unchanged from v1.2.1.
